I brought my puppy in for a grooming appointment at Petco and he ended up being rejected. I completely understand why, and I don’t have hard feelings about them not being able to groom him. My puppy is still young and can be difficult, so I get that not every dog is an easy client.

However, I was disappointed with the groomer’s approach. I really wish they would have taken a little time to gain his trust first instead of jumping straight into handling him. The experience felt rushed and not very welcoming.

Overall, I understand the decision, but I wish the groomer showed more professionalism, patience, and friendliness. It would’ve made the situation feel a lot better.
